title: Toward Sustainable Distributed LLM Inference: A Systems Synthesis and Research Agenda for an Energy-, Carbon-, and Cache-Aware llm-d Control Plane
abstract: arXiv:2609.05565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) sustainability is increasingly a serving-systems problem, not only a training problem. In production, energy and carbon impact depend on more than model size: workload shape, batching, key-value (KV) cache reuse, prefill/decode placement, model and accelerator choice, power state, geographic carbon intensity, and service-level objectives (SLOs) all matter. Recent systems papers study many of these factors separately. This paper connects those results and asks a practical engineering question: what do they imply when the decision point is a distributed inference control plane such as llm-d?   The contribution here is synthesis, not a new set of benchmark results. Reported performance, energy, carbon, and cost improvements remain the results of the cited papers and systems. I group the literature into recurring design patterns and use those patterns to sketch a Sustainable Inference Control Plane (SICP) for llm

translated_title: 迈向可持续的分布式大语言模型推理：面向能源、碳排与缓存感知的llm-d控制平面的系统综合与研究议程
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的可持续性日益成为一个服务系统问题，而不仅仅是训练问题。在生产环境中，能源和碳排的影响不仅取决于模型大小：工作负载形态、批处理、键值（KV）缓存复用、预填充/解码任务放置、模型与加速器选择、电源状态、地理碳强度以及服务级目标（SLO）等因素都至关重要。近期的系统研究论文分别单独探讨了其中的许多因素。本文将这些研究结果联系起来，并提出一个实际的工程问题：当决策点是像llm-d这样的分布式推理控制平面时，这些研究结果意味着什么？本文的贡献在于综合归纳，而非提出新的基准测试结果。所报告的性能、能源、碳排和成本方面的改进仍是所引用论文和系统的成果。我将相关文献归纳为反复出现的设计模式，并利用这些模式为llm-d勾勒出一个可持续推理控制平面（SICP）。
tldr: 本文综合现有系统研究成果，归纳出可复用的设计模式，提出面向llm-d分布式推理控制平面的能源、碳排与缓存感知的可持续推理控制平面（SICP）框架与研究议程。
en_tdlr: This paper synthesizes existing systems research into recurring design patterns and proposes an energy-, carbon-, and cache-aware Sustainable Inference Control Plane (SICP) framework and research agenda for the llm-d distributed inference control plane.
